items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...There's Cyril Sinclair, bass brass -- [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, oh great bass brass. One of the finest.

ctx.x: Those arrangements were so clean and -- You know, I forgot all about those arrangements he had did for RCA Victor.
Yeah, this is an RCA -- French RCA Volume 7071, Charlie Johnson Orchestra, and Charlie Johnson's items from 1927.
